rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded/thinned-zona blastocyst with favorable ICM and TE broadly consistent with the provided 3AA grade, but relies heavily on the lab grade and includes uncertainty/imprecision rather than image-specific detail.

Integrates age, PCOS, ovarian reserve, prior biochemical pregnancies, endometrial thickness, semen parameters, BMI, and lifestyle with prognosis and transfer planning; only minor overinterpretation of the low oocyte yield for PCOS.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, linking embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis and recommendations; minor issues include speculative comments about fresh transfer and overstating some PCOS-related concerns.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and guideline-concordant, including preference for single embryo transfer and caution against unproven adjuncts; slight deviations include somewhat liberal discussion of PGT-A after limited failures and a questionable rationale tying SET to OHSS/twin rates in PCOS.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future cycles, including SET, luteal support review, possible progesterone check, uterine evaluation if recurrence continues, and consideration of freeze-all/PGT-A; useful though not highly protocol-specific.
